title: A harmonized human glioblastoma enhancer atlas (snATAC-seq, 51 patients, 8 cohorts, 1.52M nuclei)
description:
Harmonized scATAC-seq atlas across 8 published GBM cohorts (51 patients, 1,523,668 nuclei, 544,735 CATLAS peaks) with pan-malignant, per-cell-type, and pan-myeloid AAV enhancer candidate shortlists. Pan-malignant pool covers 45/51 patients (575,971 cells; CNV | label union). Reports apply the Allen Institute Armamentarium Daigle Z-score (Z ≥ 2) criterion and distal-promoter (|dist to TSS| ≥ 2 kb, no upper cap for AAV).

Cohorts (see cohort_attribution.csv for full citation and accession): gbm_space (Greenwald 2024 Cell / E-MTAB-17183), gse276177 (Sojka 2025 Nat Cell Biol / GSE276177 — slug 'khan_astro' is a misnomer), tcga_scatac (Sundaram 2024 / GDC dbGaP phs001287), gbm_tme_atlas_hra004942 (Zhao 2024 CRM / HRA004942), mathewson_lupien (Mathewson 2021 Cell / GSE163654 + Wang 2024 Sci Adv), gse138794 (Guo 2020 Nat Commun), guilhamon (Guilhamon 2021 eLife / GSE139860), gse165037 (Nagaraja 2021 sci-ATAC / GSE165037).

Primary deliverables: pan_malignant_report_v3.html (617 clean AAV candidates for pan-malignant), per_celltype_report.html (10 cell types), pan_myeloid_report.html (TAM ∪ microglia, 380 shared peaks), FINDINGS.md (11 QC checks), methods_comparison.md (per-cohort snATAC methods appendix).

Pipeline source: github.com/jpmcginnis/HumanAAVProject (Glioblastoma snATACseq pipeline subdirectory). CNV fix for fragments-mode cohorts documented in CHANGELOG.md — previously 12 patients (9 tcga_scatac + 3 Sojka/GSE276177) were silently excluded; v1.0.0 includes them.

notes: Prepared in support of a June 2026 NIH R01 submission for AAV-delivered cell-type-specific enhancer therapy in GBM. 100 kb distance cap deliberately omitted for AAV enhancer nomination (enhancer is extracted from genomic context in the viral cassette; native-genome distance to the nominally regulated gene is irrelevant). See SCHEMA.md for frozen column definitions and CHANGELOG.md for version history.
